description:
As a deployment engineer, you are preparing for a rollout update by verifying the contents of a SQLite database used by the application. The database is located at /home/user/deployment/db/app_release.db. Your task is to list all table names in the app_release.db SQLite database and save the output to a file named /home/user/deployment/logs/tables_list.log. The log file tables_list.log must contain the names of the tables, one per line, with no extra spaces or blank lines. The exact output should only include the table names—no headers, explanations, or SQLite prompts. For example, if the database has tables named users and settings, the file should be formatted as: 
users
settings
Do not include any text that is not a table name.
